title: Challenges in Automated Debiasing for Toxic Language Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the False Positive Rate (FPR) of toxicity classifiers on tweets containing specific triggers (e.g., non-offensive minority identity mentions, possibly offensive minority mentions, and profanity), as well as evaluating model performance on an adversarial test set containing implicit toxicity without overt lexical cues.

Measuring the Pearson correlation between the estimated probability of a tweet being in African American English (AAE) and its predicted toxicity, evaluating the False Positive Rate (FPR) on AAE tweets, and calculating the disparity in toxicity flagging rates between self-reported African American and White authors.
